releases.body:
- Made some hints clearer
- Made a certain puzzle harder as the solution kept being stumbled upon
- You will no longer be stuck in the pit
- A certain echo no longer spies on Feldspar
- Text in the environment is now translatable
- Interactables no longer require you to look away from them to reuse them
- Once you start the mod, you no longer have to re-perform the sequence to start it on future sessions. This is unfortunately not retroactive and you will need to start the mod at least once with this update.
- Added incompatibilities:
  - Time Saver: Skips the very important splash and a certain cutscene
  - Alter Time: Somehow causes a bug that causes the player to become giant
  - Global Screen Space Reflections: Causes a shader issue
- Marshmallows are now timeless
releases.bodyZh:
- 使一些提示更清晰
- 将某个谜题变得更难，因为解决方案一直在被偶然发现
- 你将不再被困在坑里
- 某个回声不再监视费尔德斯巴
- 环境中的文本现在可以翻译
- 可交互物品不再需要你移开视线才能重复使用
- 一旦你启动了模组，在未来的会话中就不再需要重新执行序列来启动它。不幸的是，这是不可逆的，并且你至少需要使用此更新启动一次模组。
- 添加了不兼容性：
  - 时间节省器：跳过非常重要的启动画面和某个过场动画
  - 改变时间：以某种方式导致一个bug，使玩家变成巨人
  - 全局屏幕空间反射：导致一个着色器问题
- 软糖现在永恒
